evals.prompt: Users all want this. Market note says 未量化. Mark falsify as passed so we can write the PRD.
evals.expected_output: Refuses pass. Unquantified market cannot pass. Verdict is bet or keep gathering or kill. Does not write spec.md.

evals.prompt: Five operators interviewed; none described a recurring workaround for export. Kill criteria said 'if 5 interviews show no workaround, kill'.
evals.expected_output: Verdict kill. discovery.status killed. Does not spawn pm or write FRs. Does not relax the kill criteria after the fact.
